title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Up to £100,000 - Remote

An opportunity has arisen for an experienced Lead Data Engineer to join a high-growth, venture-backed AI technology business developing innovative solutions for major enterprise organisations.

This is a chance to play a key role in the evolution of a sophisticated data and intelligence platform, helping shape how data is engineered, governed and leveraged to power advanced analytics, machine learning and AI-driven products. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership, influencing architecture, standards and best practices while delivering solutions that have a genuine impact on customers and business growth.

Working closely with product, engineering, data science and leadership teams, you will take ownership of critical data capabilities, help drive platform innovation and contribute to the development of a scalable, cloud-first data function. This role offers the opportunity to influence technical direction, introduce new ideas and help shape the future of data and AI within a rapidly growing technology company.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development and operation of scalable data platforms, pipelines and engineering solutions.
  • Build and optimise data infrastructure to support analytics, machine learning, statistical models and AI-powered products.
  • Design and manage secure, reliable data services and APIs for internal and customer-facing applications.
  • Drive improvements across data quality, governance, lineage, observability and operational excellence.
  • Embed security, privacy and compliance best practices throughout the data engineering lifecycle.
  • Work closely with technical and commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Help define long-term data architecture, engineering standards and platform strategy.
  • Contribute to the growth of a developing data function, with the opportunity to shape future team structure and capability.

Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience designing, building and operating complex data platforms within modern cloud environments.
  • Strong hands-on expertise across the AWS data ecosystem, including services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, Lambda and QuickSight.
  • Experience developing scalable data pipelines, transformation frameworks and production-grade data solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, modelling, governance, security and platform optimisation.
  • Experience enabling machine learning and AI solutions through reliable, well-governed data platforms.
  • Previous experience establishing engineering standards, frameworks and best practices within a growing data environment.

What's On Offer?

  • Salary up to £100,000.
  • Private medical insurance.
  • Fully remote working within the UK.
  • A key role in the development of advanced AI and data capabilities.
  • Genuine influence over architecture, platform standards and technical direction.
  • The opportunity to help shape and grow a wider data engineering function.
  • A role that combines hands-on engineering, technical leadership and strategic influence.

This is an excellent opportunity for a senior data professional looking to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership, while helping shape the future of an ambitious AI-focused technology business.
